title: Resources
description: Images, videos and documents that your flows send. Pick them in the media field of Send Image, Send File and Send Video.
name: Name
empty: No resources yet. Upload the first one.
fileHelp: Images (jpg, png, gif, webp), video (mp4) and documents (pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, txt, zip). Up to the size limit set for this server.
nameHelp: Unique in this workspace, up to 100 characters. Cannot contain / \ { or }.
groupHelp: One level. Pick a group or type a new one.
deleteQuestion: Delete "{{name}}" and its file? This cannot be undone.
